method.disclosures: Publication date from provider metadata, not independently audited original PDF. Entry at close of the first full IHSG session strictly after publication date; 5/20-session price response versus same-date IHSG. Intraday timestamp/timezone availability unverified. Overlapping disclosure events are not pooled into a strategy or causal effect.
method.analog: Same issuer, same close/SMA50/SMA200 regime and Z20 bucket (<-1, -1..1, >1) as latest observation. Features use only current/past data. 20-session horizon, next-session close entry. Candidates spaced >21 sessions; selection/cooldown before outcome guards. Only matured, complete positive-price/volume paths, no >40% jumps. Historical matched conditions, not a forecast.
method.evaluation: Chronological quarterly monitoring of fixed net-buy-positive/Z20>=2 events from Screener, next-close entry, non-overlap. Prior sample counts include only events whose 20D exit precedes the quarter. No fitted model or genuine prospective holdout: retrospective fixed-rule walk-forward diagnostic, not validated alpha.
method.cost: 0/10/25 bps per side on both issuer and same-date IHSG proxy: (1+gross)*(1-c)/(1+c)-1. These are sensitivity assumptions, not observed execution fees. No leverage, dividends, impact or executable index product.
method.limits: Current LQ45 membership, not historical membership; raw price adjustment unverified. Small dependent samples; Wilson hit-rate CI is exploratory, not return CI or prediction probability. Report snapshot values are not historical features. Filings response is provider text, not independently audited source-document content. No legal clearance inferred.

corporate_actions.agm_result:
Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and the audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting a full release of liability to the Board. It also ratified the Micro and Small Business Funding Program (PUMK) Financial Report.
Agenda #2: Shareholders approved allocating 79% of the 2025 net profit as cash dividends totaling Rp44.47 trillion and 21% as retained earnings. The final dividend to be distributed is Rp376.95 per share, following an interim dividend paid in January 2026.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 remuneration for the Board and Directors and 2025 performance-based pay.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved the appointment of Public Accountant Yovita and KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global Limited) to audit the 2026 financial statements and PUMK reports.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved the updated Recovery Plan in compliance with OJK Regulation No. 5 of 2024 and authorized the Board to execute necessary actions.
Agenda #6: The company reported on the realization of funds used from Green Bond I Phase II 2025 and Sustainability Bond I Phase I 2025. This item was for reporting purposes only and did not require a shareholder decision.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved a share buyback program with a maximum value of Rp1.167 trillion and the allocation of treasury stocks for employee and management share ownership programs.
Agenda #8: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners, with approval from Series B shareholders, to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Work Plan (RJPP) and 2027 Annual Work Plan (RKAP).
Agenda #9: The meeting approved amending the Articles of Association to reclassify 485,333,332 Series B shares owned by the Republic of Indonesia into Series A Dwiwarna shares.
Agenda #10: Shareholders approved changes to the management composition, including the reappointment of Timothy Utama as Director of Operations and the confirmation of a 12-member Board of Directors and 6-member Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #11: The Board of Directors was granted power of attorney to notarize meeting decisions and perform necessary adjustments required by authorities.
Agenda #12: The meeting achieved a quorum with 85.5975% shareholder attendance, and the official summary of the results was submitted by the Corporate Secretary on April 30, 2026.

broker.reason: Ranking deskriptif hanya untuk kode broker dalam arsip lokal. Hash file cocok dengan inventaris, tetapi endpoint asal belum tercatat dan cakupan bukan seluruh broker. Kode broker bukan identitas pemilik manfaat.
broker.method: Net = sum(bval) − sum(sval). Pembeli: net positif terbesar; penjual: net negatif terbesar secara absolut. Periode memakai tanggal record yang tersedia pada semua kode broker; missing tidak diisi nol. Porsi = (beli+jual broker)/sum(beli+jual seluruh broker dalam sampel), bukan pangsa seluruh pasar; transaksi antarbroker dapat terhitung pada kedua sisi.
